name: io.github.extensiondev/mcp
title: extension.dev Browser Extensions
description: Build, run, debug, test and ship Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari extensions from your AI agent.

packageArguments.name: --features
packageArguments.description: Tool groups to expose. local is everything that runs on this machine; local,platform adds the extension.dev tools that share, release and submit to the stores, which need a login.

packageArguments.name: --project
packageArguments.description: Pin the server to one extension.dev project, so only that project's login is used.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_DEV_FEATURES
environmentVariables.description: Same as --features: the tool groups to expose.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_DEV_NO_SHIP
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse every call that puts something in front of other people: publish, promote, a real store submit, a share link or a share revoke. The --no-ship flag does the same.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_DEV_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Same as --project: pin the server to one extension.dev project.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_DEV_NO_AUTO_OPEN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to stop the server from opening the approval page in the default browser when a platform act needs a human approval.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_DEV_NO_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to send no telemetry (the one scaffold event and the per-install id header). DO_NOT_TRACK=1 does the same.
